CustomField.description: Role of a child campaign in a staged campaign (parent with one child per role): Source (all members to handle, priority, recontact date), Operational (in the mail cycle), Offer (offer made, finished), Not interested, Not reacted (no reaction after the last mail). Members move between sister campaigns (same parent) by role (Svc_CampaignMove).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stage of this campaign under its parent: Source, Operational, Offer, Not interested or Not reacted. Members are moved between the sister campaigns by this role.
CustomField.label: Campaign Role
